name: ChatGPT Canvas
tagline: Canvas is a collaborative workspace inside ChatGPT that opens a side-by-side editor for writing and coding projects. Instead of getting a code block in the chat, Canvas gives you a full editor where ChatGPT can make targeted edits, add comments, suggest rewrites for specific sections, and adjust length or reading level — all without regenerating the entire document. For code, it adds inline debugging, unit test generation, and language translation. Canvas represents a shift from ChatGPT as a chatbot to ChatGPT as a collaborative working environment.
